note: The dispatch-hint table: the local equivalent of kushin77/deepseek#79's 'feed lessons back as dispatch hints'. The hint transport is the brain directive / claim chain. Every hint carries the lesson id, an issue reference, and a commit sha; a bare string is refused by the gate.

hints.text: Ship the contract text the gate asserts before wiring the gate.
Lessons enter the ticket graph as typed edges; the peer learns of them through a reviewed direction item, never a silent copy.
Prefer a rebuildable projection over a hand-maintained second store.
